description: How an anchored panel (TmOverlayPanel, TmDropdown, TmPopover) presents itself on a narrow viewport: the floating popover anchored to the trigger, or a bottom sheet. Auto follows the viewport scope — a content-height bottom sheet on mobile, the anchored popover otherwise — so an anchored menu keeps one implementation and adapts its presentation. The popover-vs-sheet choice resolves from the viewport; the popover's size still follows the trigger's container.

members.name: Popover
members.description: The anchored floating panel, at every viewport width.

members.name: Sheet
members.description: A content-height bottom sheet (TmDrawer Position=Bottom, Modal) with a header title and a Done action that closes it.

members.name: Auto
members.description: Follows the viewport scope: a bottom sheet on a mobile viewport, the anchored popover otherwise. With no viewport scope the first frame renders InitialMode.
